question: List all workflows showing the name and category of each.
expected_sql: SELECT name, category FROM workflows
generated_sql: SELECT name, category FROM workflows ORDER BY id

question: Show the name and status of every task.
expected_sql: SELECT name, status FROM tasks
generated_sql: SELECT name, status FROM tasks ORDER BY id

question: Which tasks are currently blocked?
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM tasks WHERE status = 'BLOCKED'
generated_sql: SELECT id, name, workflow_id, priority, assigned_user_id, due_date FROM tasks WHERE status = 'BLOCKED' ORDER BY id

question: List the workflows sorted by category, and within each category by name.
expected_sql: SELECT category, name FROM workflows ORDER BY category, name
generated_sql: SELECT name, category FROM workflows ORDER BY category, name

question: Show the 5 unfinished tasks with the earliest deadlines.
expected_sql:
SELECT name, due_date FROM tasks
WHERE status <> 'COMPLETED'
ORDER BY due_date
LIMIT 5
generated_sql: SELECT name, due_date, status FROM tasks WHERE status <> 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY due_date ASC LIMIT 5

question: What is the highest number of tasks belonging to any single workflow?
generated_sql: SELECT MAX(task_count) AS max_tasks FROM (SELECT workflow_id, COUNT(*) AS task_count FROM tasks GROUP BY workflow_id) t

question: For each user, how many tasks are they assigned? Include users with none.
expected_sql:
SELECT u.full_name, COUNT(t.id) AS task_count
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.assigned_user_id = u.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name
generated_sql:
SELECT u.id, u.full_name, COUNT(t.id) AS task_count
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.assigned_user_id = u.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name
ORDER BY u.id

question: Which departments have more than 2 users?
expected_sql:
SELECT department FROM users
GROUP BY department
HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
generated_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY department HAVING COUNT(*) > 2

question: Show each task's name alongside the name of the workflow it belongs to.
expected_sql:
SELECT t.name AS task_name, w.name AS workflow_name
FROM tasks t
JOIN workflows w ON w.id = t.workflow_id
generated_sql: SELECT t.name AS task_name, w.name AS workflow_name FROM tasks t JOIN workflows w ON w.id = t.workflow_id ORDER BY t.id

question: For each blocked task, show the task name, the workflow name and the workflow owner's name.
expected_sql:
SELECT t.name AS task_name, w.name AS workflow_name, o.full_name AS owner
FROM tasks t
JOIN workflows w ON w.id = t.workflow_id
JOIN users o ON o.id = w.owner_user_id
WHERE t.status = 'BLOCKED'
generated_sql: SELECT t.name AS task_name, w.name AS workflow_name, u.full_name AS workflow_owner_name FROM tasks t JOIN workflows w ON w.id = t.workflow_id JOIN users u ON u.id = w.owner_user_id WHERE t.status = 'BLOCKED' ORDER BY t.id

question: List every user together with how many workflows they own, including those who own none.
expected_sql:
SELECT u.full_name, COUNT(w.id) AS workflow_count
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN workflows w ON w.owner_user_id = u.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name
generated_sql:
SELECT u.full_name, COUNT(w.id) AS workflow_count
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN workflows w ON w.owner_user_id = u.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name
ORDER BY workflow_count DESC, u.id

question: Which tasks have no completion date recorded?
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL
generated_sql: SELECT id, name FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL

question: Which unfinished tasks are due within the next 7 days, including today?
expected_sql:
SELECT name FROM tasks
WHERE status <> 'COMPLETED'
  AND due_date >= CURRENT_DATE
  AND due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days'
generated_sql:
SELECT id, name, status, priority, due_date, assigned_user_id
FROM tasks
WHERE status <> 'COMPLETED'
  AND due_date >= CURRENT_DATE
  AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY due_date

question: Label each unfinished task as 'Overdue' if its due date has passed and 'On time' otherwise.
expected_sql:
SELECT name,
       CASE WHEN due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Overdue' ELSE 'On time' END AS label
FROM tasks
WHERE status <> 'COMPLETED'
generated_sql: SELECT name, due_date, CASE WHEN due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Overdue' ELSE 'On time' END AS status_label FROM tasks WHERE status <> 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY id

question: Which users are assigned at least one critical task?
expected_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u.full_name
FROM users u
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM tasks t
  WHERE t.assigned_user_id = u.id AND t.priority = 'CRITICAL'
)
generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.full_name
FROM users u
JOIN tasks t ON t.assigned_user_id = u.id
WHERE t.priority = 'CRITICAL'
ORDER BY u.id

question: Work out how many unfinished tasks each user has, then list the users with more than 2 of them.
expected_sql:
WITH open_counts AS (
  SELECT assigned_user_id, COUNT(*) AS open_tasks
  FROM tasks
  WHERE status <> 'COMPLETED' AND assigned_user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY assigned_user_id
)
SELECT u.full_name, oc.open_tasks
FROM open_counts oc
JOIN users u ON u.id = oc.assigned_user_id
WHERE oc.open_tasks > 2
generated_sql:
SELECT u.id, u.full_name, COUNT(t.id) AS unfinished_tasks
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.assigned_user_id = u.id AND t.status <> 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name
HAVING COUNT(t.id) > 2
ORDER BY unfinished_tasks DESC, u.id

question: Show each task alongside the total number of tasks belonging to the same workflow.
expected_sql:
SELECT name,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY workflow_id) AS workflow_task_count
FROM tasks
generated_sql: SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.name AS task_name, t.workflow_id, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.workflow_id) AS workflow_task_count FROM tasks t ORDER BY t.workflow_id, t.id

question: Which active users have more than 2 unfinished tasks?
expected_sql:
SELECT u.full_name
FROM users u
JOIN tasks t ON t.assigned_user_id = u.id
WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status <> 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name
HAVING COUNT(t.id) > 2
generated_sql:
SELECT u.id, u.full_name, COUNT(t.id) AS unfinished_tasks
FROM users u
JOIN tasks t ON t.assigned_user_id = u.id AND t.status <> 'COMPLETED'
WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name
HAVING COUNT(t.id) > 2
ORDER BY unfinished_tasks DESC, u.id

question: Which workflows are healthy, meaning they have no overdue and no blocked tasks?
expected_sql:
SELECT w.name
FROM workflows w
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM tasks t
  WHERE t.workflow_id = w.id
    AND (t.status = 'BLOCKED'
         OR (t.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND t.status <> 'COMPLETED'))
)
generated_sql:
SELECT w.id, w.name
FROM workflows w
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM tasks t
    WHERE t.workflow_id = w.id
      AND t.due_date < CURRENT_DATE
      AND t.status <> 'COMPLETED'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM tasks t
    WHERE t.workflow_id = w.id
      AND t.status = 'BLOCKED'
)
ORDER BY w.id

question: How much work is still outstanding in each workflow?
expected_sql:
SELECT w.name, COUNT(t.id) AS outstanding
FROM workflows w
LEFT JOIN tasks t
       ON t.workflow_id = w.id AND t.status <> 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY w.id, w.name
generated_sql:
SELECT w.name AS workflow_name, COUNT(t.id) AS outstanding_tasks
FROM workflows w
LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.workflow_id = w.id AND t.status <> 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY w.id, w.name
ORDER BY outstanding_tasks DESC, w.id
